designationHistory.indexText: Coachella Valley National Wildlife Refuge was established when the Fish and Wildlife Service acquired about 1,384 acres from The Nature Conservancy to protect the endangered Coachella Valley fringe-toed lizard.

authority.citation: Endangered Species Act of 1973; Land and Water Conservation Fund Act
